conclusion: General reliability for unreviewed client audits is NOT validated. Real resolution and scope limitations remain; successful scans and tests are not proof of complete vulnerability detection.

method.cloning: All four applications cloned inside Docker at fixed Git commits. Initial library/demo clones were abandoned and are not counted.
method.execution: Scanner and native Maven/Gradle/pip resolution inside Docker; HTML rendering in local headless Chrome. Applications were not deployed and exploitability was not demonstrated.
method.scan_profile: --report html,json,sbom --cve-offline --retries 0. Public CVEProject snapshot from 2026-11-17 08:52 UTC; other sources enabled online; isolated caches, no credentials or user configuration copied. Image scanning off by product default.
method.seed_harness_issue: Initial copied SQLite seed lacked application_id/user_version; corrected in isolated copies before successful scans. This was a preparation error, not a scanner defect.
method.source_limits: EUVD HTTP 403 and CVEProject/npm incomplete or undecidable coverage are preserved in per-run reports. Exact warnings vary between runs.
